exact_command_notes.python_placeholder: <PYTHON> must be a Python >=3.9 interpreter that can import pandas, numpy, pytest, and at least one parquet engine accepted by this spec.
exact_command_notes.no_personal_absolute_path: The command intentionally does not pin a machine-local virtualenv path; the actual interpreter path and package versions are recorded by the receipt at runtime.
exact_command_notes.receipt_placeholders: <VALIDATE_RECEIPT_JSON> and <RUN_RECEIPT_JSON> are no-overwrite paths selected for the concrete run package.

authorization_package_binding.false_state: When execution_authorized is false, authorized_package_commit may be null.
authorization_package_binding.true_state: When execution_authorized is true, authorized_package_commit must be a non-empty string equal to the current git HEAD commit SHA, and load_execute_permit() must reject null or mismatched values.
authorization_package_binding.cycle_break: The authorization object is itself a checksum-manifest member, so it cannot bind the manifest SHA without a circular dependency. The post-review package is instead bound by the commit SHA in the later, independent authorization-flip commit.

bound_artifacts.fixtures_note: 『fixtures 全部通过』指上列五个文件全部通过；不得只跑其中之一；通过数只从 pytest 输出解析并写入 receipt，不在规格中硬编码。
bound_artifacts.checksum_manifest_status: Checksum manifest is a required machine gate, not an optional or pending reference. The commander will sign this v7 manifest after plan v7 and run spec v5 are written; validate-only must fail closed on missing manifest, path drift, digest drift, missing rows, or extra rows.

implemented_machine_gates.machine_check: The CLI --run-spec path must exactly match configs/research_authorization.json#authorizations.rq015a_concentration_audit.run_spec_path and execution_contract_path; mismatch is rejected.
The checksum manifest is read line-by-line and SHA-256 checked against checksum_manifest_members; digest drift, missing member rows, or extra rows produce machine_verdict=FAIL.

The fixture gate reads the fixtures array from this spec, executes each listed test file, and summarizes results; set mismatch or any failure produces machine_verdict=FAIL. The pass count is parsed from runtime output, not hardcoded.

Execute requires a validate receipt with every required field and valid types, machine_verdict=PASS, run spec path/schema version/checksum manifest path matching this spec and the authorization binding, and current input digests matching the receipt before constructing any MeasurementReader; any mismatch aborts.
load_execute_permit() requires authorized_package_commit to be non-empty and equal to the current git HEAD when execution_authorized is true; null or mismatched commits abort.

input_digest_policy.mtime_ns_role: metadata only; never included in hash input
input_digest_policy.sha_mismatch_abort: Any input SHA-256 mismatch from the validate-phase record aborts before execution.

environment.note: v1 的『纯标准库』为误述：feature matrix 与 OnSite 孪生文件为 parquet。<PYTHON> 必须满足本节依赖；实际解释器路径与各包版本由 receipt 在运行时记录，不在本规格中钉死。输入文件一律用全文件 SHA-256；mtime_ns 只作为元数据记录，不进入文件或目录 manifest 的哈希输入。

input_root_constraints.resolution: Each input root must resolve to an absolute path that remains inside the repository root.
input_root_constraints.escape_policy: ../ segments, absolute paths, and symlink-resolved paths that escape the repository root abort.
input_root_constraints.symlink_policy: Reject every symlink inside input roots; do not follow symlinks and do not define follow rules.
input_root_constraints.reason: Avoid directory cycles and repository-boundary escapes.

aggregation_key_encoding.parse_rule: Split only on unescaped separators and assignments, then unescape components.

trust_boundary: 直接调用内部函数，或用 object.__new__ / pickle / 元类伪造对象，不在信任模型内。
边界内必须成立：(a) 从公开 CLI 出发的任何可达路径都不得绕过 permit 校验、allowlist 回源核对、或结构列 denylist；(b) 外部对象不得替换掉已经过校验的对象。

checks: run spec path binding matches authorization object
checksum manifest full SHA-256 verification over checksum_manifest_members
all RQ015A fixtures pass; actual pass count is parsed from pytest output and recorded in receipt
input root existence + full-file SHA-256 record
input roots resolve under repository root and contain no symlinks

phases.authorization_gate: validate-receipt structural/binding/digest checks, load_execute_permit() double-key authorization, path binding, and authorized_package_commit binding must succeed before any MeasurementReader is constructed

receipt_required_fields.input_sha256: full-file SHA-256 per file or directory manifest_sha256 per input root; directory manifest_sha256 hashes only path/bytes/sha256 entries, with mtime_ns metadata excluded from the hash input
receipt_required_fields.metadata.run_spec_path: validate receipt must record the run spec path it validated
receipt_required_fields.metadata.checksum_manifest.path: validate receipt must record the checksum manifest filename checked from this spec
receipt_required_fields.metadata.runtime_environment: actual interpreter path, python version, package versions, parquet engine name/version
receipt_required_fields.metadata.factor_analysis: factor outputs include n_bootstrap_defined and n_bootstrap_undefined
receipt_required_fields.aggregation_key_derivation: must report rq015a-aggregation-key-v2 and product_row_key escaping policy

known_schema_v2_defects.defect: The schema entry is inconsistent with the other ARTIFACT_NOT_PRESENT_LOCALLY entries: it lacks rq007_split_applicable, rq007_split_value, expansion_factor, and collapse_factor, and records recoverability as L4_UNRECOVERABLE rather than ARTIFACT_NOT_PRESENT_LOCALLY.
known_schema_v2_defects.why_it_matters: identity_3 is measurement_rows = sum over recoverability counts; the same absent-local rows otherwise have two competing recoverability values, making the sum ambiguous.
known_schema_v2_defects.current_implementation_handling: T1 forces ARTIFACT_NOT_PRESENT_LOCALLY for schema-status ARTIFACT_NOT_PRESENT_LOCALLY rows before constructing absent coverage.

abort_conditions: run spec path mismatch with authorization object
checksum manifest validation fails, is missing, has missing member rows, or has extra member rows
fixture list in runtime does not match the fixtures array in this spec
execute is invoked without a validate receipt
input SHA differs from validate phase full-file SHA-256 or directory manifest record
input root resolves outside repository root
any symlink appears within an input root
duplicate primary key or unmapped role
attempts replay or writes any frozen artifact
authorized_package_commit is null or differs from current git HEAD when execution_authorized=true
validate receipt is missing required fields, has invalid field types, records machine_verdict other than PASS, or records run spec/schema/checksum bindings that differ from this spec
